{"consolidated_memory":"CRASH LOOP IN INFRA/K8S/DEPLOYMENT.YAML — THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Recurring pattern: Crash loops occurred in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml in the same code corner, appearing after infrastructure changes. Common signal across all: containers restarting a few seconds after start. Reproduction method for all: roll out to small node pool.

OCCASION 1 [2026-02-23]
- Trigger: After rolling restart of fleet
- Root cause: Schema drift between migration and model
- Impact: 40 duplicate rows per day stopped being written
- Fix: Regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum
- PR #1221, branch fix/crash-loop-1

OCCASION 2 [2026-07-06]
- Trigger: On first request after cold start
- Root cause: Naive datetime compared against aware datetime
- Impact: Error rate dropped from 8.0% to under 5 per 10,000 (improvement measured)
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #6051, branch fix/crash-loop-2

OCCASION 3 [2026-07-29]
- Trigger: Only for tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- Root cause: Clock skew between two hosts
- Impact: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 42 consecutive days (improvement measured)
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #9291, branch fix/crash-loop-3

All three fixes applied to the same area of infra/k8s/deployment.yaml, allowing context carryover across incidents."}
